settings.text: Manipulators, probe arms, probe tips, wafer chucks and supporting equipment — manufactured by SemiProbe. Browse the full range, configure what you need, and order online.
Eight families covering probe positioning, contact, wafer handling and supporting equipment.
Micrometer-driven X, Y and Z probe positioning, in MA-8005, MA-9000, MA-9100 and MA-8500 series with magnetic, vacuum or bolt-down bases.
Motorized probe positioning supplied complete with controller, joystick, cables and power supply. Available with 4-axis and 8-axis controllers.
Connect the manipulator to the probe tip. Coaxial and triaxial in short and long versions, plus high frequency arms in West/East and North/South orientations.
Non-thermal vacuum chucks that hold die, partial wafers and whole wafers. Standard concentric-ring and high frequency vacuum-hole patterns.
Solid tungsten tips with consistent geometry for repeatable contact, for DC and low-frequency probing. Sold by the box.
Single-leadscrew jaws that clamp packaged parts, die, substrates and printed circuit boards. Will also hold a wafer chuck.
Quiet, small-footprint pumps that supply vacuum to chucks and vacuum-based manipulators. 115 V and 230 V versions.
Compact compressors for floating a vibration isolation table or raising a pneumatic microscope lift. 115 V and 230 V versions.
